title: Memphis as the Rabbit Foot headquarters and Red Davis
summary: Each season began with three weeks' rehearsal in Memphis; off-season he played with drummer Red Davis; 14 years in all with the Rabbit Foot.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Let me see here. Did you ever work in Memphis much? Or did the shows always play there usually? Well, that was the Rabbit Foot Show headquarters. And well every year we would go to Memphis to rehearse. Start out. Three weeks rehearsal. Then we would hit the road with the show. Well when the show would close, we'd come back and close in Memphis. The show would close in Memphis. Well I would always join a little band there and hook up with a fella there called Red Davis. He was a drummer. Red Davis was a drummer there in Memphis. He would always give them a little work. We used to work over in West Memphis. Which is in Arkansas. They call it West Memphis. Well after the show closed I'd work around there and I'd be a little work. I'd work around there maybe two or three months with him. Until I get tired then I'd come back home. Yeah. New Orleans. That'll tell the next season. Go back to Memphis again. Start rehearsing.
How many years were you with the Rabbit Foot about? Well altogether I worked with the Rabbit Foot Show 14 years. 14? That's how long. I've seen a lot of other musicians come and go I guess.
